title.zh: 卷三十九 本紀第三十九: 順帝二
title.raw: 卷三十九 本紀第三十九: 順帝二 Volume 39 Annals 39: Shundi 2

sentences.zh: 順帝二

translations.literal: Shundi 2
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 2

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬戌，太陰犯右執法。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, on renxu day, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the first month of spring in the second year, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯角宿。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宿松縣地震，山裂。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Susong County suffered an earthquake and mountains split apart.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Susong County was struck by an earthquake and mountains split apart.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，置都水庸田使司於平江。

translations.literal: That month, the Office of Diked Fields and Wasteland Reclamation was established at Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Office of Diked Fields and Wasteland Reclamation was established at Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，以阿裏海牙家藏書畫賜伯顏。

translations.literal: Third month, on wushen day, the books and paintings from Alihaiya's family collection were bestowed on Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the third month, the books and paintings from Alihaiya's family collection were bestowed on Bayan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以按灰為大宗正府也可劄魯忽赤，總掌天下奸盜詐偽。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, An Hui was appointed colonel of the Grand Imperial Clan Court and given overall charge of adultery, theft, and fraud throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, An Hui was appointed colonel of the Grand Imperial Clan Court and given overall charge of adultery, theft, and fraud throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以累朝御服朱衣、七寶項牌賜伯顏。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, imperial robes of vermilion from successive reigns and seven-jewel neck plaques were bestowed on Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, imperial robes of vermilion from successive reigns and seven-jewel neck plaques were bestowed on Bayan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，日赤如赭，壬戌，復如之。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the sun's color was like ochre; on renxu day, again likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day the sun was red as ochre; on the renxu day it was again the same.

sentences.zh: 賜征東元帥府軍士冬衣及甲。

translations.literal: Winter clothing and armor were granted to the soldiers of the Eastern Campaign Marshal's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Winter clothing and armor were granted to the soldiers of the Eastern Campaign Marshal's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 諸軍討廣西徭，久無功，敕行省、行臺、廉訪司官共督之。

translations.literal: The armies suppressing the Yao in Guangxi had long achieved no success; branch secretariat, traveling censorate, and surveillance commission officials were jointly directed to supervise them.
translations.idiomatic: The armies suppressing the Yao in Guangxi had long achieved no success. Officials of the branch secretariat, traveling censorate, and surveillance commission were jointly directed to supervise the campaign.

sentences.zh: 順州民饑，以鈔四千錠賑之。

translations.literal: The people of Shunzhou faced famine; four thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shunzhou faced famine, and four thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed for relief.

sentences.zh: 夜，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: At night, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: That night the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the sun's color was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯箕宿。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the moon transgressed the mansion of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the moon transgressed the mansion of Ji.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 賜宗王火兒灰母答裏鈔一千錠。

translations.literal: One thousand ingots of paper money were granted to Darli, mother of the imperial prince Huo'erhui.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand ingots of paper money were granted to Darli, mother of the imperial prince Huo'erhui.

sentences.zh: 以撒敦上都居第賜太保定住，仍敕有司籍撒敦家財。

translations.literal: Sadun's residence at Shangdu was bestowed on Grand Preceptor Dingzhu, and officials were further directed to register Sadun's household property.
translations.idiomatic: Sadun's residence at Shangdu was bestowed on Grand Preceptor Dingzhu, and officials were directed to register Sadun's household property.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，復四川鹽井之禁。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the prohibition on Sichuan salt wells was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the prohibition on Sichuan salt wells was restored.

sentences.zh: 以按答木兒家人田宅賜太保定住。

translations.literal: The fields and dwellings of Andadamur's family were bestowed on Grand Preceptor Dingzhu.
translations.idiomatic: The fields and dwellings of Andadamur's family were bestowed on Grand Preceptor Dingzhu.

sentences.zh: 以汪家奴為宣政院使，加金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Wangjianu was appointed commissioner of the Xuanzheng Commission and promoted to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Luminous Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Wangjianu was appointed commissioner of the Xuanzheng Commission and promoted to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Luminous Happiness.

sentences.zh: 造武宗、英宗、明宗三朝皇后玉冊、玉寶。

translations.literal: Jade registers and jade seals were made for the empresses of the reigns of Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Jade registers and jade seals were made for the empresses of the reigns of Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong.

sentences.zh: 是月，陜西暴風，旱，無麥。

translations.literal: That month, Shaanxi suffered violent wind and drought; there was no wheat.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shaanxi suffered violent wind and drought, and there was no wheat harvest.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑朔，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the dingchou new moon, the sun's color was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou new moon of the fourth month of summer, the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 禁民間私造格例。

translations.literal: Private compilation of legal precedents among the people was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The private compilation of legal precedents among the people was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封駙馬孛羅帖木兒為毓德王。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the imperial son-in-law Boluo Temür was enfeoffed as Prince of Yude.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the imperial son-in-law Boluo Temür was enfeoffed as Prince of Yude.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太陰犯角宿。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the moon transgressed the Horn mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禁服麒麟、鸞鳳、白兔、靈芝、雙角五爪龍、八龍、九龍、萬壽、福壽字、赭黃等服。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, it was forbidden to wear garments bearing qilin, phoenixes, white rabbits, lingzhi fungus, double-horned five-clawed dragons, eight dragons, nine dragons, the characters for "ten thousand years" and "fortune and longevity," ochre-yellow, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, it was forbidden to wear garments bearing qilin, phoenixes, white rabbits, lingzhi fungus, double-horned five-clawed dragons, eight dragons, nine dragons, the characters for "ten thousand years" and "fortune and longevity," ochre-yellow, and the like.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以知樞密院事帖木兒不華為中書平章政事，撒迪為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Temür Buqa was appointed associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, and Sadi was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Temür Buqa was appointed associate administrator of the Central Secretariat, and Sadi was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣使以香、幣賜武當、龍虎二山。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, envoys were dispatched with incense and silks as offerings to Mount Wudang and Mount Longhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, envoys were dispatched with incense and silks as offerings to Mount Wudang and Mount Longhu.

sentences.zh: 詔以太平路為郯王徹徹禿食邑；

translations.literal: An edict made Taiping Circuit the fief of Prince of Tan Cheche Tu;
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Taiping Circuit the fief of Prince of Tan Cheche Tu;

sentences.zh: 以集慶、廬州、饒州禿禿哈民戶賜伯顏，仍於句容縣設長官所領之。

translations.literal: the tutuha households of Jiqing, Luzhou, and Raozhou were bestowed on Bayan, and a magistrate's office was established at Jurong County to administer them.
translations.idiomatic: the tutuha households of Jiqing, Luzhou, and Raozhou were bestowed on Bayan, and a magistrate's office was established at Jurong County to administer them.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the imperial carriage traveled seasonally to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 拜中書左丞耿煥為侍御史，王懋德為中書左丞。

translations.literal: Left Vice Chancellor Geng Huan was appointed supervising censor, and Wang Maode was appointed left vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Chancellor Geng Huan was appointed supervising censor, and Wang Maode was appointed left vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 賜宗室灰裏王金一錠、鈔一千錠，毓德王孛羅帖木兒鈔三千錠，公主八八鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: The imperial clansman Huiliwang was granted one ingot of gold and one thousand ingots of paper money; Prince of Yude Boluo Temür, three thousand ingots; Princess Baba, two thousand ingots.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clansman Huiliwang was granted one ingot of gold and one thousand ingots of paper money; Prince of Yude Boluo Temür, three thousand ingots; and Princess Baba, two thousand ingots.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午朔，黃河復於故道。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the bingwu new moon, the Yellow River returned to its old course.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the fifth month, the Yellow River returned to its old course.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Administrative Star.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Administrative Star.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，南陽、鄧州大霖雨，自是日至於六月甲申，湍河、白河大溢，水為災。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Nanyang and Dengzhou suffered great torrential rain; from that day through the sixth month on jiashen day, the Tuan River and Bai River greatly overflowed, and the waters became a disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day torrential rains struck Nanyang and Dengzhou. From that day through the jiashen day of the sixth month, the Tuan River and Bai River burst their banks and flooding wrought disaster.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太白晝見，丁巳，亦如之。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Venus was visible in daylight; on dingsi day, again likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Venus was visible in daylight; on the dingsi day it was again the same.

sentences.zh: 壬申，秦州山崩。

translations.literal: On renshen day, mountains collapsed in Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, mountains collapsed in Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，婺州不雨，至於六月。

translations.literal: That month, Wuzhou received no rain, continuing until the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wuzhou received no rain, and drought continued until the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，禁諸王、駙馬從衛服只孫衣，系絳環。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on dingchou day, princes and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to have their retinues wear zhisun robes with crimson rings attached.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the sixth month, princes and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to have their retinues wear zhisun robes with crimson rings attached.

sentences.zh: 贈宗王忽都答兒為雲安王，謚忠武；

translations.literal: The imperial prince Hududar was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yun'an, with posthumous name Zhongwu;
translations.idiomatic: The imperial prince Hududar was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yun'an, with the posthumous name Zhongwu;

sentences.zh: 羅羅歹為保寧王，謚昭勇。

translations.literal: Luoluodai was made Prince of Baoning, with posthumous name Zhaoyong.
translations.idiomatic: Luoluodai was made Prince of Baoning, with the posthumous name Zhaoyong.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命中書平章政事阿吉剌知經筵事。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Associate Administrator Ajila was ordered to oversee Lectern affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Associate Administrator Ajila was ordered to oversee Lectern affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以鐵木兒補化為江浙行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Temür Buqa was appointed left chancellor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Temür Buqa was appointed left chancellor of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 太白犯井宿。

translations.literal: Venus transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以汴梁、大名諸路脫別臺地土賜伯顏。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the lands of Tuobietai in Bianliang, Daming, and other circuits were bestowed on Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the lands of Tuobietai in Bianliang, Daming, and other circuits were bestowed on Bayan.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎忽裏臺請復科舉取士之制，不聽。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Hulitai requested restoration of the civil-service examination system for selecting scholars; the request was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Hulitai requested restoration of the civil-service examination system for selecting scholars. The request was not approved.

sentences.zh: 庚子，涇水溢。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the Jing River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the Jing River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以鈔五千錠賜吳王搠失江。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, five thousand ingots of paper money were granted to Prince of Wu Sishijiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, five thousand ingots of paper money were granted to Prince of Wu Sishijiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，詔以公主奴倫引者思之地五千頃賜伯顏。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingwu day, an edict bestowed on Bayan five thousand qing of land at Yinzhesi belonging to Princess Nulun.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the seventh month of autumn, an edict bestowed on Bayan five thousand qing of land at Yinzhesi belonging to Princess Nulun.

sentences.zh: 以衛輝路賜衛王寬徹哥為食邑。

translations.literal: Weihui Circuit was granted as the fief of Prince of Wei Kuanchige.
translations.idiomatic: Weihui Circuit was granted as the fief of Prince of Wei Kuanchige.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Venus transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Venus transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以定住、鎖南參議中書省事。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Dingzhu and Suonan were appointed to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Dingzhu and Suonan were appointed to deliberate on Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，發阿魯哈、不蘭奚駱駝一百一十上供太皇太后乘輿之用。

translations.literal: On renzi day, one hundred ten camels from Aruqa and Bulanxi were dispatched as tribute for the grand empress dowager's carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, one hundred ten camels from Aruqa and Bulanxi were dispatched as tribute for the grand empress dowager's carriage.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Venus transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Venus transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 庚申，禁隔越中書口傳敕旨，冒支錢糧。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, it was forbidden to bypass the Central Secretariat with orally transmitted edicts and fraudulently draw funds and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, it was forbidden to bypass the Central Secretariat with orally transmitted edicts and fraudulently draw funds and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命有司以所籍撒敦寶器分賜伯顏及太保定住。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, officials were ordered to divide the registered treasures of Sadun and bestow them on Bayan and Grand Preceptor Dingzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, officials were ordered to divide the registered treasures of Sadun and bestow them on Bayan and Grand Preceptor Dingzhu.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，中書平章政事孛羅徙宅，賜金二錠、銀十錠。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Associate Administrator Boluo moved his residence and was granted two ingots of gold and ten ingots of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Associate Administrator Boluo moved his residence and was granted two ingots of gold and ten ingots of silver.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕賜上都孔子廟碑，載累朝尊崇之意。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, it was directed that a stele be granted to the Confucius temple at Shangdu, recording the reverence of successive reigns.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, it was directed that a stele be granted to the Confucius temple at Shangdu, recording the reverence of successive reigns.

sentences.zh: 省諸王、公主、駙馬從衛糧賜之數。

translations.literal: The grain grants to the retinues of princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The grain grants to the retinues of princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were reduced.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命宗王不蘭奚，駙馬月魯不花、帖古思、教化鎮薛連可、怯魯連之地，各賜鈔六百錠及銀牌遣之。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the imperial prince Bulanxi and the imperial sons-in-law Yuelu Buqa, Tigusi, and Jiaohua were ordered to guard the lands of Xueliankex and Qielulian; each was granted six hundred ingots of paper money and a silver tally and dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the imperial prince Bulanxi and the imperial sons-in-law Yuelu Buqa, Tigusi, and Jiaohua were ordered to guard the lands of Xueliankex and Qielulian. Each was granted six hundred ingots of paper money and a silver tally and dispatched.

sentences.zh: 是月，黃州蝗，督民捕之，人日五斗。

translations.literal: That month, locusts struck Huangzhou; the people were compelled to catch them — five dou per person per day.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts struck Huangzhou, and the people were compelled to catch them at a quota of five dou per person per day.

sentences.zh: 以鈔二千錠賑新收阿速軍扈從車駕者，每戶鈔二錠，死者人一錠。

translations.literal: Two thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed for relief to the newly recruited Asud guard accompanying the imperial carriage — two ingots per household, one ingot per deceased person.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed for relief to the newly recruited Asud guard accompanying the imperial carriage: two ingots per household and one ingot for each deceased person.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the jiaxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 高郵大雨雹。

translations.literal: Gaoyou suffered heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoyou was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 詔：「雲南、廣海、八番及甘肅、四川邊遠官死而不能歸葬者，有司給糧食舟車護送還鄉。

translations.literal: An edict said: "For officials in Yunnan, Guanghai, the Eight Banners, Gansu, and Sichuan who die in remote border posts and cannot return home for burial, the authorities shall supply grain, boats, and carts to escort them back to their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared, "When officials serving in remote border posts in Yunnan, Guanghai, the Eight Banners, Gansu, and Sichuan die and cannot be returned home for burial, the authorities shall supply grain, boats, and carts to escort their remains back to their native districts.

sentences.zh: 去鄉遠者，加鈔二十錠；

translations.literal: For those far from home, twenty additional ingots of paper money shall be granted;
translations.idiomatic: For those far from home, twenty additional ingots of paper money shall be granted;

sentences.zh: 無親屬者，官為瘞之。

translations.literal: for those without kin, officials shall bury them."
translations.idiomatic: and for those without kin, officials shall bury them."

sentences.zh: 」命威順王寬徹不花還鎮湖廣。

translations.literal: " Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua was ordered to return and guard Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua was ordered to return and resume his post guarding Huguang.

sentences.zh: 先是，伯顏矯制召之至京，至是帝遣歸藩。

translations.literal: Previously, Bayan had forged an edict summoning him to the capital; now the emperor sent him back to his fief.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Bayan had forged an edict summoning him to the capital; now the emperor sent him back to his fief.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 大都至通州霖雨，大水，敕軍人修道。

translations.literal: From Dadu to Tongzhou torrential rain fell and great flooding occurred; soldiers were directed to repair the roads.
translations.idiomatic: From Dadu to Tongzhou torrential rain fell and great flooding occurred. Soldiers were directed to repair the roads.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太陰犯箕宿。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the moon transgressed the mansion of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the moon transgressed the mansion of Ji.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以徽政院、中政院財賦府田租六萬三千三百石補本年海運未敷之數，令有司歸其直。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, sixty-three thousand three hundred shi of rent from the revenue estates of the Huizheng and Zhongzheng commissions was applied to make up the shortfall in that year's sea transport, and officials were ordered to repay its value.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, sixty-three thousand three hundred shi of rent from the revenue estates of the Huizheng and Zhongzheng commissions was applied to make up the shortfall in that year's sea transport, and officials were ordered to repay its value.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，立屯衛於馬劄罕之地。

translations.literal: On renchen day, an agricultural garrison was established at Mazahan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, an agricultural garrison was established at Mazahan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔：「強盜皆死，盜牛馬者劓，盜驢騾者黥額，再犯劓，盜羊豕者墨項，再犯黥，三犯劓；

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an edict said: "All robbers shall die. Those who steal cattle or horses shall have their noses cut off. Those who steal donkeys or mules shall be tattooed on the forehead; on a second offense their noses shall be cut off. Those who steal sheep or pigs shall be branded on the neck; on a second offense tattooed; on a third offense their noses shall be cut off;
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, an edict declared, "All robbers shall die. Those who steal cattle or horses shall have their noses cut off. Those who steal donkeys or mules shall be tattooed on the forehead; on a second offense their noses shall be cut off. Those who steal sheep or pigs shall be branded on the neck; on a second offense tattooed; on a third offense their noses shall be cut off;

sentences.zh: 劓後再犯者死。

translations.literal: those who offend again after nose-cutting shall die.
translations.idiomatic: those who offend again after nose-cutting shall die.

sentences.zh: 盜諸物者，照其數估價。

translations.literal: Theft of other goods shall be assessed according to quantity and estimated value.
translations.idiomatic: Theft of other goods shall be assessed according to quantity and estimated value.

sentences.zh: 省、院、臺、五府官三年一次審決。

translations.literal: Officials of the secretariat, academies, censorate, and Five Offices shall review and decide cases once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the secretariat, academies, censorate, and Five Offices shall review and decide cases once every three years.

sentences.zh: 著為令。

translations.literal: Let this be established as statute."
translations.idiomatic: Let this be established as statute."

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，減馬湖路泥溪、平夷、蠻夷、夷都、沐川、雷坡六長官司，並為三。

translations.literal: " On xinchou day, the six native-official districts of Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, Yidu, Muchuan, and Leipo in Mahu Circuit were reduced and consolidated into three.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the six native-official districts of Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, Yidu, Muchuan, and Leipo in Mahu Circuit were reduced and consolidated into three.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，熒惑犯太微垣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengxu day, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the ninth month, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，弛鞏昌總帥府漢人軍器之禁。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the prohibition on Han military weapons in the Gongchang command headquarters was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the prohibition on Han military weapons in the Gongchang command headquarters was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the imperial procession returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 海運糧至京，遣官致祭天妃。

translations.literal: Sea-transport grain arrived at the capital, and officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices to Tianfei.
translations.idiomatic: Sea-transport grain arrived at the capital, and officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices to Tianfei.

sentences.zh: 是月，臺州路饑，發義倉、募富人出粟賑之。

translations.literal: That month, Taizhou Circuit faced famine; charity granaries were opened and wealthy households were urged to contribute grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Taizhou Circuit faced famine. Charity granaries were opened and wealthy households were urged to contribute grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 沅州路盧陽縣饑，賑糶米六千石。

translations.literal: Luyang County in Yuanzhou Circuit faced famine; six thousand shi of rice was disbursed for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Luyang County in Yuanzhou Circuit faced famine, and six thousand shi of rice was disbursed for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingzi day, Mars transgressed the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the tenth month of winter, Mars transgressed the Left Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 己卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命參知政事納麟監繪明宗皇帝御容。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Vice Administrator Nalin was ordered to supervise the painting of Emperor Mingzong's imperial portrait.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Vice Administrator Nalin was ordered to supervise the painting of Emperor Mingzong's imperial portrait.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔：「每日，右丞相伯顏，太保定住，中書平章政事孛羅、阿吉剌聚議於內廷。

translations.literal: On jihai day, an edict said: "Each day, Right Chancellor Bayan, Grand Preceptor Dingzhu, and Associate Administrators Boluo and Ajila shall assemble for deliberation in the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, an edict declared, "Each day Right Chancellor Bayan, Grand Preceptor Dingzhu, and Associate Administrators Boluo and Ajila shall assemble for deliberation in the inner court.

sentences.zh: 平章政事塔失海牙，右丞鞏卜班，參知政事納麟、許有壬等聚議於中書。

translations.literal: Associate Administrators Tashihaiya and Right Vice Chancellor Gongbuban, and Vice Administrators Nalin, Xu Youren, and others shall assemble for deliberation at the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Administrators Tashihaiya and Right Vice Chancellor Gongbuban, and Vice Administrators Nalin, Xu Youren, and others shall assemble for deliberation at the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 」太陰犯進賢。

translations.literal: " The moon transgressed Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 是月，撫州、袁州、瑞州諸路饑，發米六萬石賑糶之。

translations.literal: That month, Fuzhou, Yuanzhou, Ruizhou, and other circuits faced famine; sixty thousand shi of rice was disbursed for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fuzhou, Yuanzhou, Ruizhou, and other circuits faced famine, and sixty thousand shi of rice was disbursed for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiyou day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eleventh month, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以那海為湖廣行省平章政事，討廣西叛徭。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Naihai was appointed Associate Administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat to suppress the rebellious Yao of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Naihai was appointed Associate Administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat to suppress the rebellious Yao of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 武宗、英宗、明宗三朝皇后升祔入廟，命官致祭。

translations.literal: The empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns were elevated for joint worship and enshrined in the temple; officials were ordered to perform sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns were elevated for joint worship and enshrined in the temple, and officials were ordered to perform sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣河南行省平章政事月珞普華於西番為僧。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Associate Administrator Yeluopuhua of the Henan Branch Secretariat was dispatched to the Western Regions to become a monk.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Associate Administrator Yeluopuhua of the Henan Branch Secretariat was dispatched to the Western Regions to become a monk.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜宣讓王帖木兒不花市宅錢四千錠，詔帖木兒不花王府官屬，朝賀班次列於有司之右。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, four thousand ingots were granted to Prince of Xuandan Temür Buqa as funds to purchase a residence; an edict directed that the officials of Temür Buqa's princely establishment, in the order of court congratulation, take rank to the right of regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, four thousand ingots were granted to Prince of Xuandan Temür Buqa as funds to purchase a residence. An edict directed that the officials of Temür Buqa's princely establishment, in the order of court congratulation, take rank to the right of regular officials.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命同知樞密院事者燕不花兼宮相都總管府達魯花赤，領隆鎮衛、左阿速衛諸軍。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Vice Administrator of the Privy Council Jayan Buqa was additionally appointed darughachi of the Palace Chancellor Directorate-General and given command of the Longzhen Guard, Left Asud Guard, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Vice Administrator of the Privy Council Jayan Buqa was additionally appointed darughachi of the Palace Chancellor Directorate-General and given command of the Longzhen Guard, Left Asud Guard, and other armies.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，安置宗王不蘭奚於梧州。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the imperial prince Bulanxi was settled at Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the imperial prince Bulanxi was settled at Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁彈弓、弩箭、袖箭。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, slingshots, crossbow bolts, and sleeve arrows were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, slingshots, crossbow bolts, and sleeve arrows were prohibited.

sentences.zh: 壬申，國公買住卒，賜鈔三百錠。

translations.literal: On renshen day, State Duke Maizhu died; three hundred ingots of paper money were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, State Duke Maizhu died, and three hundred ingots of paper money were granted.

sentences.zh: 印造至元三年鈔本一百五十萬錠。

translations.literal: One million five hundred thousand ingots of Zhiyuan third-year paper money were printed.
translations.idiomatic: One million five hundred thousand ingots of Zhiyuan third-year paper money were printed.

sentences.zh: 是月，松江府上海縣饑，發義倉糧及募富人出粟賑之。

translations.literal: That month, Shanghai County in Songjiang Prefecture faced famine; grain from benevolence granaries was disbursed and the wealthy were solicited to contribute grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shanghai County in Songjiang Prefecture faced famine. Grain from benevolence granaries was disbursed and the wealthy were solicited to contribute grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 安豐路饑，賑糶麥四萬二千四百石。

translations.literal: Anfeng Circuit faced famine; forty-two thousand four hundred shi of wheat was sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Anfeng Circuit faced famine, and forty-two thousand four hundred shi of wheat was sold for relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiaxu day, the sun was red as ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the twelfth month, the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命興元府鳳州留壩鎮及晉寧路遼山縣十八盤各立巡檢司。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, inspection offices were ordered established at Liuba Town in Feng Prefecture of Xingyuan Prefecture and at Shibapan in Liaoshan County, Jinning Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, inspection offices were ordered established at Liuba Town in Feng Prefecture of Xingyuan Prefecture and at Shibapan in Liaoshan County, Jinning Circuit.

sentences.zh: 宗王也孫帖木兒進西馬三匹。

translations.literal: The imperial prince Yesun Temür presented three Western horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial prince Yesun Temür presented three Western horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 賜文濟王蠻子金印、驛券及從衛者衣並糧五千石。

translations.literal: Prince of Wenji Manzi was granted a gold seal, courier vouchers, clothing for his guard retinue, and five thousand shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wenji Manzi was granted a gold seal, courier vouchers, clothing for his guard retinue, and five thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 詔省、院、臺、翰林、集賢、奎章閣、太常禮儀院、禮部官定議寧宗皇帝尊謚、廟號。

translations.literal: An edict directed officials of the secretariat, privy council, censorate, Hanlin Academy, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, Kuizhang Pavilion, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Ministry of Rites to deliberate and fix Emperor Ningzong's posthumous honorific and temple name.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed officials of the secretariat, privy council, censorate, Hanlin Academy, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, Kuizhang Pavilion, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Ministry of Rites to deliberate and fix Emperor Ningzong's posthumous honorific and temple name.

sentences.zh: 是月，江州諸縣饑，總管王大中貸富人粟以賑貧民，而免富人雜徭以為息，約年豐還之，民不病饑。

translations.literal: That month, counties in Jiangzhou faced famine; Administrator Wang Dazhong lent grain borrowed from the wealthy to relieve the poor, exempting the wealthy from miscellaneous corvée as interest, with agreement to repay when the year was abundant — the people did not suffer from hunger.
translations.idiomatic: That month the counties of Jiangzhou faced famine. Administrator Wang Dazhong borrowed grain from the wealthy to relieve the poor, exempting the wealthy from miscellaneous corvée as interest on the loan with agreement to repay when harvests were abundant — and the people did not suffer from hunger.

sentences.zh: 慶元慈溪縣饑，遣官賑之。

translations.literal: Cixi County in Qingyuan Circuit faced famine; officials were dispatched for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Cixi County in Qingyuan Circuit faced famine, and officials were dispatched for relief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔整治驛傳。

translations.literal: That year, an edict ordered the rectification of courier stations and relay transport.
translations.idiomatic: That year an edict ordered the rectification of courier stations and relay transport.

sentences.zh: 以甘肅行省白城子屯田之地賜宗王喃忽裏。

translations.literal: The garrison-agriculture lands of Baichengzi in the Gansu Branch Secretariat were bestowed on the imperial prince Nanhuli.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison-agriculture lands of Baichengzi in the Gansu Branch Secretariat were bestowed on the imperial prince Nanhuli.

sentences.zh: 以燕鐵木兒居第賜灌頂國師曩哥星吉，號大覺海寺，塑千佛於其內。

translations.literal: Yan Temür's residence was bestowed on the State Preceptor of Abhiseka Nangexingji; it was named the Great Awakening Ocean Temple, and a thousand Buddhas were sculpted within it.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür's residence was bestowed on the State Preceptor of Abhiseka Nangexingji. It was named the Great Awakening Ocean Temple, and a thousand Buddhas were sculpted within it.

sentences.zh: 江浙旱，自春至於八月不雨，民大饑。

translations.literal: Jiangsu and Zhejiang suffered drought; from spring until the eighth month there was no rain, and the people faced severe famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu and Zhejiang suffered drought. From spring until the eighth month there was no rain, and the people faced severe famine.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸卯，廣州增城縣民朱光卿反，其黨石昆山、鐘大明率眾從之，偽稱大金國，改元赤符。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, on guimao day, Zhu Guangqing of Zengcheng County, Guangzhou, rebelled; his followers Shi Kunshan and Zhong Daming led crowds after him, falsely proclaiming the Great Jin state and changing the era name to Chifu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the guimao day of the first month of spring, Zhu Guangqing of Zengcheng County, Guangzhou, rebelled. His followers Shi Kunshan and Zhong Daming rallied crowds to join him, falsely proclaiming the Great Jin state and adopting the era name Chifu.

sentences.zh: 命指揮狗劄裏、江西行省左丞沙的討之。

translations.literal: Commander Gouzhali and Left Vice Chancellor Shadi of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Gouzhali and Left Vice Chancellor Shadi of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat were ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大都南北兩城設賑糶米鋪二十處。

translations.literal: On wushen day, twenty relief rice-sale shops were established in the northern and southern districts of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, twenty relief rice-sale shops were established in the northern and southern districts of the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，升祔懿璘只班皇帝於廟，謚沖聖嗣孝皇帝，廟號寧宗。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Emperor Yilianzhen Shiraban was elevated for joint enshrinement in the temple; his posthumous title was Emperor Chong Sheng Si Xiao and his temple name Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Emperor Yilianzhen Shiraban was elevated for joint enshrinement in the temple. His posthumous title was Emperor Chong Sheng Si Xiao and his temple name Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 豫王阿剌忒納失裏買池州銅陵產銀地一所，請用私財煆煉，輸納官課，從之。

translations.literal: Prince of Yu Alte Naseri purchased a silver-producing tract at Tongling in Chizhou Circuit; he requested to smelt it at his own expense and pay official levies — the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yu Alte Naseri purchased a silver-producing tract at Tongling in Chizhou Circuit and requested to smelt it at his own expense while paying official levies. The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立宣鎮侍衛屯田萬戶府於寧夏。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the Xuanzhen Guard Garrison-Agriculture Ten-thousand Households Office was established at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the Xuanzhen Guard Garrison-Agriculture Ten-thousand Households Office was established at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，月食。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, there was a lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, there was a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，日有交暈，左右珥上有白虹貫之。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the sun had crossing halos; left and right pendant halos were pierced by a white rainbow.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the sun had crossing halos, and left and right pendant halos were pierced by a white rainbow.

sentences.zh: 戊午，帝獵於柳林，凡三十五日。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the emperor hunted at Willow Grove — thirty-five days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the emperor hunted at Willow Grove for thirty-five days in all.

sentences.zh: 監察御史醜的、宋紹明進諫，帝嘉納之，賜金、幣。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Chou Di and Song Shaoming submitted remonstrances; the emperor commended and accepted them and granted gold and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Chou Di and Song Shaoming submitted remonstrances. The emperor commended and accepted them and granted gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 醜的等固辭，帝曰：「昔魏征進諫，唐太宗未嘗不賞，汝其受之。

translations.literal: Chou Di and the others firmly declined; the emperor said: "In olden days when Wei Zheng remonstrated, Emperor Taizong of Tang never failed to reward him — you must accept.
translations.idiomatic: Chou Di and the others firmly declined, but the emperor said, "In olden days when Wei Zheng remonstrated, Emperor Taizong of Tang never failed to reward him — you must accept.

sentences.zh: 」是月，臨江路新淦州、新喻州，瑞州民饑，賑糶米二萬石。

translations.literal: " That month, people in Xingan and Xinyu prefectures of Linjiang Circuit and Ruizhou faced famine; twenty thousand shi of rice was sold for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of Xingan and Xinyu prefectures in Linjiang Circuit and of Ruizhou faced famine, and twenty thousand shi of rice was sold for relief.

sentences.zh: 封晉郭璞為靈應侯。

translations.literal: Guo Pu of Jin was enfeoffed as Marquis of Spiritual Responsiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu of Jin was enfeoffed as Marquis of Spiritual Responsiveness.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Second month, on the first day renshen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, renshen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 棒胡反於汝寧信陽州。

translations.literal: Bang Hu rebelled at Xinyang Prefecture in Runing.
translations.idiomatic: Bang Hu rebelled at Xinyang Prefecture in Runing.

sentences.zh: 棒胡本陳州人，名閏兒，以燒香惑眾，妄造妖言作亂，破歸德府鹿邑，焚陳州，屯營於杏岡，命河南行省左丞慶童領兵討之。

translations.literal: Bang Hu was originally a man of Chen Prefecture, named Run'er; he deluded the masses with incense-burning and wondrous talk, falsely stirring rebellion, sacked Guide Prefecture's Luyi, burned Chen Prefecture, and encamped at Xinggang; Left Vice Chancellor Qingtong of the Henan Branch Secretariat was ordered to lead troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Bang Hu was originally a man of Chen Prefecture named Run'er. He deluded the masses with incense-burning and wondrous talk and raised rebellion, sacking Luyi in Guide Prefecture, burning Chen Prefecture, and encamping at Xinggang. Left Vice Chancellor Qingtong of the Henan Branch Secretariat was ordered to lead troops to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 紹興路大水。

translations.literal: Shaoxing Circuit suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing Circuit suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立船戶提舉司十處，提領二十處。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, ten boat-household supervisory offices and twenty subordinate posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, ten boat-household supervisory offices and twenty subordinate posts were established.

sentences.zh: 定船戶科差，船一千料之上者，歲納鈔六錠，以下遞減。

translations.literal: Boat-household levies were fixed: for vessels of one thousand piculs' burden and above, six ingots of paper money per year, decreasing by stages below that.
translations.idiomatic: Boat-household levies were fixed: for vessels of one thousand piculs' burden and above, six ingots of paper money per year, decreasing by stages below that.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以上太皇太后玉冊、玉寶，恭謝太廟。

translations.literal: On renwu day, thanks were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple upon bestowing the jade book and jade seal upon the grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, thanks were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple upon bestowing the jade book and jade seal upon the grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲申，定服色、器皿、輿馬之制。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, regulations for official dress, utensils, and carriages and horses were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, regulations for official dress, utensils, and carriages and horses were established.

sentences.zh: 己丑，汝寧獻所獲棒胡彌勒佛、小旗、偽宣敕並紫金印、量天尺。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Runing presented items captured from Bang Hu: a Maitreya Buddha image, small banners, a forged edict, and a purple-gold seal and heaven-measuring rod.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Runing presented items captured from Bang Hu: a Maitreya Buddha image, small banners, a forged edict, a purple-gold seal, and a heaven-measuring rod.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，發鈔四十萬錠，賑江浙等處饑民四十萬戶，開所在山場、河泊之禁，聽民樵采。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, four hundred thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed to relieve four hundred thousand famine-stricken households in Jiangsu-Zhejiang and elsewhere; prohibitions on mountain woods and river fisheries were lifted to allow the people to gather fuel and harvest.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, four hundred thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed to relieve four hundred thousand famine-stricken households in Jiangsu-Zhejiang and elsewhere. Prohibitions on mountain woods and river fisheries were lifted to allow the people to gather fuel and harvest.

sentences.zh: 廣西徭賊復反，命湖廣行省平章那海、江西行省平章禿兒迷失海牙總兵捕之。

translations.literal: The Yao bandits in Guangxi rebelled again; Associate Administrators Naihai of the Huguang Branch Secretariat and Tu'er Mishi Haiya of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat were ordered to command troops jointly to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao bandits in Guangxi rebelled again. Associate Administrators Naihai of the Huguang Branch Secretariat and Tu'er Mishi Haiya of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat were ordered to command troops jointly to capture them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太保定住薨，給賜殯葬諸物。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Grand Preceptor Dingzhu died; gifts for burial and funeral were provided.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Grand Preceptor Dingzhu died, and gifts for burial and funeral were provided.

sentences.zh: 庚子，中書參知政事納麟等請立采珠提舉司。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Vice Administrator Nalin and others of the Central Secretariat requested establishment of a pearl-fishing supervisory office.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Vice Administrator Nalin and others of the Central Secretariat requested establishment of a pearl-fishing supervisory office.

sentences.zh: 先是，嘗立提舉司，泰定間以其煩擾罷去，至是納麟請復立之，且以采珠戶四萬賜伯顏。

translations.literal: Previously a supervisory office had been established; it was abolished in the Taiding era for being burdensome; now Nalin requested its restoration, and moreover the forty thousand pearl-fishing households were granted to Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: A supervisory office had previously been established but was abolished in the Taiding era for being burdensome. Now Nalin requested its restoration, and moreover the forty thousand pearl-fishing households were granted to Bayan.

sentences.zh: 是月，發義倉米賑蘄州及紹興饑民。

translations.literal: That month, rice from benevolence granaries was disbursed to relieve famine victims in Qizhou and Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: That month rice from benevolence granaries was disbursed to relieve famine victims in Qizhou and Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，太陰犯靈臺。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinhai day, the moon transgressed Lingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the third month, the moon transgressed Lingtai.

sentences.zh: 發鈔一萬錠，賑大都寶坻饑民。

translations.literal: Ten thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed to relieve famine victims in Baodi in the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand ingots of paper money were disbursed to relieve famine victims in Baodi in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以玉寶、玉冊立弘吉剌氏伯顏忽都為皇后，因雨輟賀。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Onggirat Borakhu was installed as empress with the jade seal and jade book; congratulations were suspended because of rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Onggirat Borakhu was installed as empress with the jade seal and jade book. Congratulations were suspended because of rain.

sentences.zh: 詔以完者帖木兒蘇州之田二百頃賜郯王徹徹禿。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed two hundred qing of fields at Suzhou belonging to Wanzhe Temür on Prince of Tan Cheche Tu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict bestowed two hundred qing of fields at Suzhou belonging to Wanzhe Temür on Prince of Tan Cheche Tu.

sentences.zh: 己未，大都饑，命於南北兩城賑糶糙米。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the capital faced famine; unpolished rice was ordered sold for relief in the northern and southern districts.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the capital faced famine, and unpolished rice was ordered sold for relief in the northern and southern districts.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，加封晉周處為英義武惠正應王。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Zhou Chu of Jin was further ennobled as King Yingyi Wuhui Zhengying.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Zhou Chu of Jin was further ennobled as King Yingyi Wuhui Zhengying.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命宗王燕帖木兒為大宗正府劄魯忽赤。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the imperial prince Yantu Temür was appointed jarquchi of the Grand Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the imperial prince Yantu Temür was appointed jarquchi of the Grand Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 是月，天雨線。

translations.literal: That month, threadlike rain fell from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: That month threadlike rain fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 發義倉糧賑溧陽州饑民六萬九千二百人。

translations.literal: Grain from benevolence granaries was disbursed to relieve sixty-nine thousand two hundred famine victims in Liyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Grain from benevolence granaries was disbursed to relieve sixty-nine thousand two hundred famine victims in Liyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，遣使降香於龍虎、三茅、閣皂諸山。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renshen day, emissaries were dispatched to burn incense at Mount Longhu, Mount Sanmao, Mount Gezao, and other mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the fourth month of summer, emissaries were dispatched to burn incense at Mount Longhu, Mount Sanmao, Mount Gezao, and other mountains.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，禁漢人、南人、高麗人不得執持軍器，凡有馬者拘入官。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Han Chinese, southern Chinese, and Goryeo people were forbidden to possess military weapons; all who owned horses were confiscated for the state.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Han Chinese, southern Chinese, and Goryeo people were forbidden to possess military weapons, and all who owned horses were confiscated for the state.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，有星孛於王良，至七月壬寅沒於貫索。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, a broom star appeared at Wangliang; on renyin day of the seventh month it vanished at Gansuo.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day a broom star appeared at Wangliang. On the renyin day of the seventh month it vanished at Gansuo.

sentences.zh: 皇后以受玉冊、玉寶，恭謝太廟。

translations.literal: The empress offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple upon receiving the jade book and jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: The empress offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple upon receiving the jade book and jade seal.

sentences.zh: 命伯顏領宣鎮侍衛軍，賜鈔三千錠，建宣鎮侍衛府。

translations.literal: Bayan was ordered to lead the Xuanzhen Guard army; three thousand ingots were granted and the Xuanzhen Guard headquarters was established.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was ordered to lead the Xuanzhen Guard army. Three thousand ingots were granted and the Xuanzhen Guard headquarters was established.

sentences.zh: 以太皇太后受冊、寶詔天下。

translations.literal: An edict was issued throughout the realm that the grand empress dowager had received the book and seal.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued throughout the realm announcing that the grand empress dowager had received the book and seal.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the imperial carriage set out on the seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, the imperial carriage set out on the seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，高麗王阿剌忒納失裏朝賀還國，賜金一錠、鈔二千錠，從官賜與有差。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the Goryeo king Alte Naseri returned home after paying court tribute; one ingot of gold and two thousand ingots of paper money were granted, and his retinue received gifts in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the Goryeo king Alte Naseri returned home after paying court tribute. One ingot of gold and two thousand ingots of paper money were granted, and his retinue received gifts in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，合州大足縣民韓法師反，自稱南朝趙王。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Han Fashi of Dazu County, He Prefecture, rebelled and styled himself King Zhao of the Southern Dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Han Fashi of Dazu County, He Prefecture, rebelled and styled himself King Zhao of the Southern Dynasty.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，謚唐杜甫為文貞。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Du Fu of Tang was granted the posthumous epithet Wenzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Du Fu of Tang was granted the posthumous epithet Wenzhen.

sentences.zh: 己亥，惠州歸善縣民聶秀卿、譚景山等造軍器，拜戴甲為定光佛，與朱光卿相結為亂，命江西行省左丞沙的捕之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Nie Xiuqing, Tan Jingshan, and others of Guishan County, Huizhou, manufactured weapons, hailed Dai Jia as the Dingguang Buddha, joined forces with Zhu Guangqing in rebellion; Left Vice Chancellor Shadi of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Nie Xiuqing, Tan Jingshan, and others of Guishan County, Huizhou, manufactured weapons, hailed Dai Jia as the Dingguang Buddha, and joined forces with Zhu Guangqing in rebellion. Left Vice Chancellor Shadi of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to capture them.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔：「省、院、臺、部、宣慰司、廉訪司及部府幕官之長，並用蒙古、色目人。

translations.literal: That month, an edict said: "The heads of branch secretariats, privy council, censorate, ministries, pacification commissions, surveillance commissions, and chief staff officers of departments and offices shall all be Mongols or persons of other colors.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict declared, "The heads of branch secretariats, privy council, censorate, ministries, pacification commissions, surveillance commissions, and chief staff officers of departments and offices shall all be Mongols or persons of other colors.

sentences.zh: 禁漢人、南人不得習學蒙古、色目文字。

translations.literal: Han Chinese and southern Chinese are forbidden to study Mongol and other-color scripts.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chinese and southern Chinese are forbidden to study Mongol and other-color scripts.

sentences.zh: 」以米八千石、鈔二千八百錠賑哈剌奴兒饑民。

translations.literal: " Eight thousand shi of rice and two thousand eight hundred ingots of paper money were disbursed to relieve famine victims in Haranur.
translations.idiomatic: Eight thousand shi of rice and two thousand eight hundred ingots of paper money were disbursed to relieve famine victims in Haranur.

sentences.zh: 龍興路南昌、新建縣饑，太皇太后發徽政院糧三萬六千七百七十石賑糶之。

translations.literal: Nanchang and Xinjian counties in Longxing Circuit faced famine; the grand empress dowager disbursed thirty-six thousand seven hundred seventy shi of grain from the Palatial Administration for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Nanchang and Xinjian counties in Longxing Circuit faced famine. The grand empress dowager disbursed thirty-six thousand seven hundred seventy shi of grain from the Palatial Administration for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，民間訛言朝廷拘刷童男、童女，一時嫁娶殆盡。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on xinchou day, popular rumors spread that the court was rounding up boys and girls; for a time marriage and betrothal were nearly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the fifth month, popular rumors spread that the court was rounding up boys and girls, and for a time marriage and betrothal were nearly exhausted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太白犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Venus transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Venus transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，給平伐、都雲定雲二處安撫司達魯花赤暗都剌等虎符。

translations.literal: On guimao day, tiger tallies were granted to Andula and others, darughachi of the Pingfa and Duyun-Dingyun pacification commissions.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, tiger tallies were granted to Andula and others, darughachi of the Pingfa and Duyun-Dingyun pacification commissions.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以興州、松州民饑，禁上都、興和造酒。

translations.literal: On yisi day, because the people of Xing Prefecture and Song Prefecture faced famine, wine-making was prohibited at Shangdu and Xinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, because the people of Xing Prefecture and Song Prefecture faced famine, wine-making was prohibited at Shangdu and Xinghe.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔：「汝寧棒胡，廣東朱光卿、聶秀卿等，皆系漢人。

translations.literal: On wushen day, an edict said: "Bang Hu of Runing, Zhu Guangqing and Nie Xiuqing of Guangdong, and the like are all Han Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, an edict declared, "Bang Hu of Runing, Zhu Guangqing and Nie Xiuqing of Guangdong, and the like are all Han Chinese.

sentences.zh: 漢人有官於省、臺、院及翰林、集賢者，可講求誅捕之法以聞。

translations.literal: Han officials serving in the secretariat, censorate, privy council, Hanlin Academy, and Academy of Scholarly Worthies should devise methods for apprehension and execution and report.
translations.idiomatic: Han officials serving in the secretariat, censorate, privy council, Hanlin Academy, and Academy of Scholarly Worthies should devise methods for apprehension and execution and report.

sentences.zh: 」太白晝見。

translations.literal: " Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太陰犯心宿。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, the moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔哈八兒禿及禿堅帖木兒為太尉，各設僚屬幕官。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, an edict appointed Qabarqu and Toghto Temür as Grand Marshals, each with his own subordinate staff officers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, an edict appointed Qabarqu and Toghto Temür as Grand Marshals, each with his own subordinate staff officers.

sentences.zh: 西番賊起，殺鎮西王子黨兀班，立行宣政院，以也先帖木兒為院使，往討之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in the Western Regions and killed Dang'u Ban, prince of Zhenxi; the Branch Commission for Buddhist Affairs was established, with Yesian Temür as commissioner to lead the punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in the Western Regions and killed Dang'u Ban, prince of Zhenxi. The Branch Commission for Buddhist Affairs was established, with Yesian Temür as commissioner to lead the punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命四川行省參知政事舉理等捕反賊韓法師。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Vice Administrator Juri and others of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat were ordered to capture the rebel Han Fashi.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Vice Administrator Juri and others of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat were ordered to capture the rebel Han Fashi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，彗星見於東北，大如天船星，色白，約長尺餘，彗指西南，至八月庚午始滅。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, a comet appeared in the northeast, as large as the Celestial Ship star, white in color, its tail about a foot long and pointing southwest; it did not vanish until gengwu day of the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, a comet appeared in the northeast, as large as the Celestial Ship star, white in color, its tail about a foot long and pointing southwest. It did not vanish until the gengwu day of the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，太白經天，辛未、甲戌，復如之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengwu day, Venus crossed the meridian; on xinwei and jiaxu days, again likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the sixth month, Venus crossed the meridian. On the xinwei and jiaxu days it was again the same.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太白犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Venus transgressed Lingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Venus transgressed Lingtai.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，贈丞相安童推忠佐運開國元勛、東平忠憲王，於所封城內建立祠廟，官為致祭。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Chancellor Antong was posthumously honored as Yuan Merit Lord Who Pushed Loyalty and Aided the Dynasty in Founding the State, King Zhongxian of Dongping; a temple was established within his enfeoffed seat and officials were directed to perform sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Chancellor Antong was posthumously honored as Yuan Merit Lord Who Pushed Loyalty and Aided the Dynasty in Founding the State, King Zhongxian of Dongping. A temple was established within his enfeoffed seat and officials were directed to perform sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太白經天。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 夜，太白犯太微垣。

translations.literal: At night, Venus transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: At night, Venus transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大霖雨，自是日至癸巳不止。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, great torrential rains fell; from that day through guisi they did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, great torrential rains fell and from that day through guisi did not cease.

sentences.zh: 京師、河南、北水溢，御河、黃河、沁河、渾河水溢，沒人畜、廬舍甚眾。

translations.literal: The capital, Henan, and the north overflowed with water; the Imperial Canal, Yellow River, Qin River, and Hun River overflowed, drowning very many people, livestock, and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: The capital, Henan, and the north were inundated. The Imperial Canal, Yellow River, Qin River, and Hun River burst their banks, drowning a great many people and animals and destroying countless dwellings.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太白晝見，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Venus was visible in daylight; the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Venus was visible in daylight and the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，設醮長春宮。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, a ritual offering was performed at the Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, a Daoist ritual offering was performed at the Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Venus transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Venus transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊子，加封文始尹真人為無上太初博文文始真君，徐甲為垂玄感聖慈化應禦真君，庚桑子洞靈感化超蹈混然真君，文子通玄光暢升元敏誘真君，列子沖虛至德遁世遊樂真君，莊子南華至極雄文弘道真君。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, additional enfeoffments were granted: Perfected Man Yin of Wen Shi as Perfect Sovereign Wen Shi of Supreme Primordium and Broad Culture; Xu Jia as Perfect Sovereign of Sagely Response, Merciful Transformation, and Imperial Response; Gengsangzi as Perfect Sovereign of Cave Spirit, Responsive Transformation, and Transcendent Harmony; Wenzi as Perfect Sovereign of Penetrating Mystery, Radiant Flow, Ascendant Origin, and Keen Persuasion; Liezi as Perfect Sovereign of Pristine Emptiness, Supreme Virtue, World Withdrawal, and Roaming Joy; Zhuangzi as Perfect Sovereign of Southern Florescence, Ultimate Grandeur, Heroic Letters, and Vast Dao.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day further ennoblements were conferred: Yin, the Perfected Man of Wen Shi, became Perfect Sovereign Wen Shi of Supreme Primordium and Broad Culture; Xu Jia became Perfect Sovereign of Sagely Response, Merciful Transformation, and Imperial Response; Gengsangzi became Perfect Sovereign of Cave Spirit, Responsive Transformation, and Transcendent Harmony; Wenzi became Perfect Sovereign of Penetrating Mystery, Radiant Flow, Ascendant Origin, and Keen Persuasion; Liezi became Perfect Sovereign of Pristine Emptiness, Supreme Virtue, World Withdrawal, and Roaming Joy; and Zhuangzi became Perfect Sovereign of Southern Florescence, Ultimate Grandeur, Heroic Letters, and Vast Dao.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太白晝見，庚寅，復如之，至七月辛酉方息。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Venus was visible in daylight; on gengyin day, again likewise; it did not cease until xinyou day of the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Venus was visible in daylight; on the gengyin day it was again the same, and the phenomenon did not cease until the xinyou day of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，彰德大水，深一丈。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Zhangde suffered great floodwaters one zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Zhangde was struck by severe flooding one zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 立高密縣濰川鄉景芝社巡檢司。

translations.literal: An inspection office was established at Jingzhi Community, Weichuan Township, Gaomi County.
translations.idiomatic: An inspection office was established at Jingzhi Community in Weichuan Township, Gaomi County.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，漳河泛溢至廣平城下。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on jihai day, the Zhang River overflowed to below Guangping city.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the seventh month of autumn, the Zhang River burst its banks and flooded up to Guangping city.

sentences.zh: 賜鞏卜班西平王印。

translations.literal: The seal of Prince of Xiping was bestowed on Gongbuban.
translations.idiomatic: Gongbuban was granted the seal of Prince of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，車駕出獵。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the imperial carriage went out hunting.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the emperor went on a hunting excursion.

sentences.zh: 太白經天。

translations.literal: Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復如之。

translations.literal: On yisi day, again likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day it was again the same.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕幸失剌斡耳朵。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the imperial carriage visited Shila Wo'erduo.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the imperial procession visited Shila Wo'erduo.

sentences.zh: 太白復經天。

translations.literal: Venus again crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: Venus again crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 丁未，車駕幸龍岡，灑馬乳以祭。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the imperial carriage visited Longgang and sprinkled mare's milk as offering.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the emperor visited Longgang and sprinkled mare's milk in sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 戊申，召朵兒只國王入朝。

translations.literal: On wushen day, King Duorzhi was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, King Duorzhi was summoned to attend court.
