sentences.zh: 是月，賑京師、河南、北被水災者。

translations.literal: That month, those in the capital, Henan, and the north who had suffered flood disaster were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month relief was disbursed to flood victims in the capital, Henan, and the north.

sentences.zh: 龍興路南昌州饑，以江西海運糧賑糶之。

translations.literal: Nanchang Prefecture in Longxing Circuit faced famine; Jiangxi sea-transport grain was disbursed for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Nanchang Prefecture in Longxing Circuit faced famine, and grain from Jiangxi's sea transport was disbursed for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，填星退犯東咸。

translations.literal: Third month, on wushen day, Saturn in retrograde transgressed East Saltern.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the third month, Saturn, in retrograde, transgressed East Saltern.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命中書平章政事阿吉剌監修《至正條格》。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Associate Administrator Ajila of the Central Secretariat was ordered to supervise compilation of the Statutes of the Zhizheng Reign.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Associate Administrator Ajila of the Central Secretariat was ordered to supervise revision of the Statutes of the Zhizheng Reign.

sentences.zh: 告祭南郊。

translations.literal: Announcement sacrifices were performed at the southern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: Announcement sacrifices were performed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 以國王朵兒只為遼陽行省左丞相，宗王玉裏不花為知樞密院事，賜鈔一千錠、金一錠、銀十錠。

translations.literal: King Duorzhi was made left chancellor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat; imperial clansman Ulug Buqa was made administrator of the Privy Council; one thousand ingots of paper money, one ingot of gold, and ten ingots of silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: King Duorzhi was appointed left chancellor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat and the imperial clansman Ulug Buqa was appointed administrator of the Privy Council. They were granted one thousand ingots of paper money, one ingot of gold, and ten ingots of silver.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，京師天雨紅沙，晝晦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinwei day, the capital's sky rained red sand; the day grew dark.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fourth month of summer, red sand fell from the sky over the capital and daylight dimmed.

sentences.zh: 以探馬赤、只兒瓦歹為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: Tammaqchi and Jirwadai were made associate administrators of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Tammaqchi and Jirwadai were appointed associate administrators of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以脫脫為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Toqto'a was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Toqto'a was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命阿吉剌為奎章大學士兼知經筵事。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Ajila was ordered to serve as Grand Academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion and concurrently oversee Lectern affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Ajila was ordered to serve as grand academician of the Kui Zhang Pavilion while concurrently overseeing the imperial lectures.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 河南執棒胡至京師，誅之。

translations.literal: Zhi Banghu of Henan arrived at the capital and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi Banghu of Henan was brought to the capital and executed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，車駕薄暮至八里塘，雨雹，大如拳，其狀有小兒、環玦、獅、象、龜、卵之形。

translations.literal: On guisi day, at dusk the imperial carriage arrived at Balitang; hail fell, as large as fists, in shapes resembling small children, ring-pendants, lions, elephants, tortoises, and eggs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, at dusk the emperor reached Balitang as hail fell, each stone as large as a fist and shaped like small children, ring-pendants, lions, elephants, tortoises, and eggs.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，立五臺山等處巡檢司。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yiwei day, inspection commissions were established at Mount Wutai and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the fifth month inspection commissions were established at Mount Wutai and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，升兩淮屯田打捕總管府為正三品。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the Lianghuai garrison-agriculture and hunting general directorate was promoted to rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day the Lianghuai garrison-agriculture and hunting directorate-general was promoted to the third rank, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，贈湖廣行省平章政事燕赤推誠翊戴安邊制勝功臣、太傅、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封永平王，謚忠襄。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Yanchi, associate administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support, Aiding the Throne, Pacifying the Borders, and Securing Victory; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and pillar of the state; was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yongping with the posthumous name Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Yanchi, associate administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support, Aiding the Throne, Pacifying the Borders, and Securing Victory; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and pillar of the state; and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yongping with the posthumous name Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔：「土番宣慰司軍士，許令乘馬，執兵器。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, an edict declared: "Soldiers of the Tubo pacification commission are permitted to ride horses and carry weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day an edict declared, "Soldiers of the Tubo pacification commission are permitted to ride horses and carry weapons.

sentences.zh: 」湖廣行省元領新化洞、古州、潭溪、龍裏、洪州諸洞三百餘處，洞民六萬餘戶，分隸靖州，立敘南、橫江巡檢司。

translations.literal: " The Huguang Branch Secretariat had originally administered more than three hundred cave districts including Xinhua Cave, Guzhou, Tanxi, Longli, and Hongzhou, with more than sixty thousand cave households; they were divided and placed under Jing Prefecture, and the Xunan and Hengjiang inspection commissions were established.
translations.idiomatic: " The Huguang Branch Secretariat had originally administered more than three hundred cave districts including Xinhua Cave, Guzhou, Tanxi, Longli, and Hongzhou, with more than sixty thousand cave-dwelling households. These were reassigned to Jing Prefecture, and the Xunan and Hengjiang inspection commissions were established.

sentences.zh: 是月，命佛家閭為考功郎中，喬林為考功員外郎，魏宗道為考功主事，考較天下郡縣官屬功過。

translations.literal: That month, Fojialü was ordered to serve as bureau director in the Board of Merit Examinations, Qiao Lin as vice director, and Wei Zongdao as secretary; they were to assess the merits and faults of officials throughout the commanderies and counties of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fojialü was appointed bureau director in the Merit Examination Office, Qiao Lin vice director, and Wei Zongdao secretary, with charge to assess the merits and faults of officials throughout the commanderies and counties of the realm.

sentences.zh: 命阿剌吉復為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: Araki was ordered to resume his post as associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Araki was restored as associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 彰德獻瑞麥，一莖三穗。

translations.literal: Zhangde presented an auspicious wheat stalk bearing three heads on one stem.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde presented an auspicious stalk of wheat with three heads on a single stem.

sentences.zh: 臨沂、費縣水，發米三萬石賑糶之。

translations.literal: Linyi and Fei counties suffered flooding; thirty thousand shi of rice was disbursed for relief sale.
translations.idiomatic: Flooding struck Linyi and Fei counties, and thirty thousand shi of rice was disbursed for relief sale.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，廣東廉訪司僉事恩莫綽言：「處決重囚，宜命五府官斟酌地裏遠近，預選官分行各道，比到秋分時畢事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengwu day, Supervising Censor Enmonuo of the Guangdong surveillance commission said: "In carrying out capital punishment of serious felons, officials of the Five Offices should be ordered, weighing geographic distance, to select officials in advance to proceed separately to each circuit, completing matters by the time of the Autumn Equinox.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the sixth month Enmonuo, an assistant of the Guangdong surveillance commission, submitted a memorial: "When executing serious felons, officials of the Five Offices should be directed, weighing the distance between places, to select officials in advance and dispatch them to each circuit separately, so that all executions may be completed by the Autumn Equinox.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，袁州民周子旺反，僭稱周王，偽改年號，尋擒獲，伏誅。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Zhou Ziwang of Yuan Prefecture rebelled, arrogated the title King of Zhou, and falsely changed the reign title; soon he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Zhou Ziwang, a commoner of Yuan Prefecture, rebelled, arrogated the title King of Zhou, and proclaimed a reign title of his own. He was soon captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 填星退犯鍵閉。

translations.literal: Saturn in retrograde transgressed Key and Lock.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn, in retrograde, transgressed Key and Lock.

sentences.zh: 壬午，立重慶路墊江縣。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Dianjiang County in Chongqing Circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Dianjiang County was established in Chongqing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 己丑，邵武路大雨，水入城郭，平地一丈。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Shaowu Circuit suffered heavy rain; water entered the city walls, one zhang on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day torrential rain struck Shaowu Circuit. Floodwaters rose one zhang above level ground within the city walls.

sentences.zh: 是月，信州路靈山裂。

translations.literal: That month, Ling Mountain in Xin Prefecture Circuit split apart.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ling Mountain in Xinzhou Circuit split apart.

sentences.zh: 漳州路南勝縣民李誌甫反，圍漳城，守將搠思監與戰，失利。

translations.literal: Li Zhifu, a commoner of Nansheng County in Zhang Prefecture Circuit, rebelled, besieged Zhang Prefecture city, and fought the defending general Toqsun, who suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhifu, a commoner of Nansheng County in Zhangzhou Circuit, rebelled and besieged Zhangzhou city. The defending general Toqsun joined battle but was defeated.

sentences.zh: 詔江浙行省平章別不花，總浙閩、江西、廣東軍討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Bedbuqa, associate administrator of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, to command the armies of Zhe-Min, Jiangxi, and Guangdong to suppress the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed Bedbuqa, associate administrator of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, to command the armies of Zhe-Min, Jiangxi, and Guangdong to suppress the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，詔以伯顏有功，立生祠於涿州、汴梁。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renyin day, an edict declared that because Bayan had achieved merit, living shrines were to be established at Zhuozhou and Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the seventh month of autumn an edict declared that because Bayan had rendered outstanding service, living shrines were to be established at Zhuozhou and Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，奉聖州地大震，損壞人民廬舍。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Fengsheng Prefecture suffered a great earthquake, damaging the dwellings of the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day a great earthquake struck Fengsheng Prefecture, destroying the people's dwellings.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，鞏昌府山崩，壓死人民。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, mountains collapsed in Gongchang Prefecture, crushing people to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day mountains collapsed in Gongchang Prefecture, crushing people to death.

sentences.zh: 戊午，為伯顏立打捕鷹房諸色人戶總管府。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, a general directorate for hunting, falconry, and various artisan households was established for Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day a directorate-general for hunting, falconry, and various artisan households was established for Bayan.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the guihai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 己巳，申取高麗女子及閹人之禁。

translations.literal: On jisi day, the prohibition on taking Goryeo women and eunuchs was formally repealed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the prohibition on taking Goryeo women and eunuchs was formally repealed.

sentences.zh: 贈伯顏察兒守誠佐治安惠世美功臣、太師、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封奉元王，謚忠宣。

translations.literal: Bayanchar was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Loyal Integrity, Assisting in Governance, Pacifying and Benefiting the Age, and Worldly Excellence; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and pillar of the state; was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fengyuan with the posthumous name Zhongxuan.
translations.idiomatic: Bayanchar was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Loyal Integrity, Assisting in Governance, Pacifying and Benefiting the Age, and Worldly Excellence; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and pillar of the state; and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fengyuan with the posthumous name Zhongxuan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宣德府地大震。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Xuande Prefecture suffered a great earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day a great earthquake struck Xuande Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，山東鹽運司於濟南歷城立濱洛鹽倉東西二場。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the Shandong salt-transport commission established eastern and western depots at the Binluo salt warehouse in Jinan Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day the Shandong salt-transport commission established eastern and western depots at the Binluo salt warehouse in Licheng, Jinan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，京師地震，日二三次，至乙酉乃止。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the capital was struck by earthquakes, two or three times daily, continuing until the yiyou day when they ceased.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the capital was struck by earthquakes two or three times a day, continuing until the yiyou day when they ceased.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，白虹貫天。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, a white rainbow spanned the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day a white rainbow spanned the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸未，改宣德府為順寧府，奉聖州為保安州。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Xuande Prefecture was renamed Shunning Prefecture and Fengsheng Prefecture was renamed Bao'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Xuande Prefecture was renamed Shunning Prefecture and Fengsheng Prefecture was renamed Bao'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 贈太保曲出推忠翊運保寧一德功臣、太師、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封廣陽王，謚忠惠。

translations.literal: Quchu was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Loyal Support, Assisting the Fortune, Preserving Tranquility, and Unified Virtue; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and pillar of the state; was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guangyang with the posthumous name Zhonghui.
translations.idiomatic: Quchu was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Loyal Support, Assisting the Fortune, Preserving Tranquility, and Unified Virtue; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and pillar of the state; and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guangyang with the posthumous name Zhonghui.

sentences.zh: 贈平章伯帖木兒宣忠濟美協誠正德功臣、太傅、開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封文安王，謚忠憲。

translations.literal: Botemür, associate administrator, was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Proclaiming Loyalty, Aiding Beauty, Harmonizing Sincerity, and Upright Virtue; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and pillar of the state; was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wen'an with the posthumous name Zhongxian.
translations.idiomatic: Botemür, associate administrator, was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject of Proclaiming Loyalty, Aiding Beauty, Harmonizing Sincerity, and Upright Virtue; was made grand preceptor, grand marshal with ceremonial rites equal to the Three Dukes, and pillar of the state; and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wen'an with the posthumous name Zhongxian.

sentences.zh: 甲申，雲南老告土官八那遣侄那賽賫象馬來朝，為立老告軍民總管府。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Bana, native official of Laogao in Yunnan, dispatched his nephew Nasai bearing elephants and horses to court; the Laogao military-civilian general directorate was established for this purpose.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Bana, native official of Laogao in Yunnan, dispatched his nephew Nasai to court with elephants and horses as tribute. A military-civilian general directorate was established at Laogao.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 閏八月戊戌，日赤如赭，己亥，復如之。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, on wuxu day the sun was red as ochre; on jihai day it was again the same.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the intercalary eighth month the sun was red as ochre. On the jihai day it was again the same.

sentences.zh: 填星犯罰星，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: Saturn transgressed Punishment Star; the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn transgressed Punishment Star and the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the sun was red as ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the sun was red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the moon transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on bingyin day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the ninth month, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白犯東咸。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Venus transgressed East Saltern.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Venus transgressed East Saltern.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，奔星如杯大，色白，起自右旗之下，西南行，沒於近濁。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, a bolide as large as a cup, white in color, rose from below the Right Banner, traveled southwest, and set near Near Turbidity.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day a bolide as large as a cup, white in color, rose from below the Right Banner, traveled southwest, and vanished near Near Turbidity.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太陰犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the moon transgressed Lingtai.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the moon transgressed Lingtai.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，日赤如赭，太白犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the sun was red as ochre; Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the sun was red as ochre and Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the tenth month of winter, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太陰犯酒旗。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the moon transgressed Wine Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the moon transgressed Wine Banner.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，改英宗殿名昭融。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingyin day, the hall name of Emperor Yingzong was changed to Zhaorong.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the eleventh month the hall name of Emperor Yingzong was changed to Zhaorong.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，立紹熙府軍民宣撫都總使司，命御史大夫脫脫兼都總使，治書侍御史吉當普為副都總使，世襲其職。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the Shaoxi Prefecture military-civilian pacification chief commission was established; Censor-in-Chief Toqto'a was ordered to serve concurrently as chief commissioner; Disciplinary Secretary Jidangpu was made deputy chief commissioner; the posts were to be hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day the Shaoxi Prefecture military-civilian pacification chief commission was established. Censor-in-Chief Toqto'a was ordered to serve concurrently as chief commissioner, Disciplinary Secretary Jidangpu was appointed deputy chief commissioner, and the posts were made hereditary.

sentences.zh: 本府元領六州、二十縣、一百五十二鎮，國初，以其地荒而廢之；

translations.literal: This prefecture had originally administered six prefectures, twenty counties, and one hundred fifty-two market-town districts; at the founding of the dynasty its lands were abandoned because they were desolate;
translations.idiomatic: This prefecture had originally administered six prefectures, twenty counties, and one hundred fifty-two market-town districts. At the founding of the dynasty its lands were abandoned because they were desolate;

sentences.zh: 至是居民二十餘萬，故立府治之。

translations.literal: By now the registered population exceeded two hundred thousand, so a prefectural administration was established to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: By now the registered population exceeded two hundred thousand, so a prefectural administration was established to govern them.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命平章政事孛羅領太常禮儀院使。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Associate Administrator Boluo was ordered to lead the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Rites Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Associate Administrator Boluo was ordered to serve as director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Rites Directorate.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯氐宿。

translations.literal: Mars transgressed the mansion of Di.
translations.idiomatic: Mars transgressed the mansion of Di.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the moon transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, the moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Venus transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Venus transgressed the Encampment and Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 壬午，四川散毛洞蠻反，遣使賑被寇人民。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the Sanmao cave barbarians of Sichuan rebelled; emissaries were dispatched to relieve the people who had suffered raiding.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day the Sanmao cave barbarians of Sichuan rebelled. Emissaries were dispatched to relieve the people who had suffered raiding.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，大都南城等處設米鋪二十，每鋪日糶米五十石，以濟貧民，俟秋成乃罷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiawu day, twenty rice-sale shops were established in the southern district of the Great Capital and other places; each shop was to sell fifty shi of rice daily to aid the poor; the scheme would be suspended after the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the twelfth month twenty rice-sale shops were established in the southern district of the Great Capital and elsewhere. Each shop was to sell fifty shi of rice daily to aid the poor, and the scheme would be suspended after the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立邦牙等處宣慰司都元帥府並總管府。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the overall command headquarters and general directorate of the Bangya and other places pacification commission were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the overall command headquarters and general directorate of the Bangya and other places pacification commission were established.

sentences.zh: 先是，世祖既定緬地，以其處雲南極邊，就立其酋長為帥，令三年一入貢，至是來貢，故立官府。

translations.literal: Previously, after Shizu had pacified Burma, because the region lay at the far southern border of Yunnan, its chieftain was appointed as commander and directed to pay tribute once every three years; now tribute came, so governmental offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, after Shizu had pacified Burma, because the region lay at Yunnan's far southern border its chieftain was appointed commander and directed to pay tribute once every three years. Now that tribute had arrived, governmental offices were established.

sentences.zh: 庚子，熒惑犯房宿。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Mars transgressed the Fang mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Mars transgressed the Fang mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以宣徽使別兒怯不花為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Bie'erqie Buqa, commissioner of the Xuanzheng Commission, was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Bie'erqie Buqa, commissioner of the Xuanzheng Commission, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太白經天，己酉，復如之。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Venus crossed the meridian; on jiyou day it was again the same.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Venus crossed the meridian. On the jiyou day it was again the same.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，加荊王脫脫木兒元德上輔廣中宣義正節振武佐運功臣之號。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Prince of Jing Toto Temür was granted the additional title of Meritorious Subject of Original Virtue, Upper Assistant, Broad Rectitude, Righteous Integrity, Upright Discipline, and Martial Aid to the Fortune.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Prince of Jing Toto Temür was granted the additional title of Meritorious Subject of Original Virtue, Upper Assistant, Broad Rectitude, Righteous Integrity, Upright Discipline, and Martial Aid to the Fortune.

sentences.zh: 太白經天。

translations.literal: Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，復如之。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, again likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day it was again the same.

sentences.zh: 壬子，熒惑犯東咸。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Mars transgressed East Saltern.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Mars transgressed East Saltern.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白犯外屏，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Venus transgressed Outer Screen and the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Venus transgressed Outer Screen and the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太白經天。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Venus crossed the meridian.
